raw_text: Apex Horizon Ventures is a premier early-stage venture capital firm. We specialize in Seed and Series A investments with check sizes typically ranging from $1,500,000 to $3,000,000 ($1.5M - $3M). Headquartered in San Francisco, CA, we actively deploy capital across North America. Core focus areas include FinTech, B2B SaaS, and Enterprise Infrastructure. Recent portfolio investments include PayStacker, CloudShield, and LedgerFlow. General Partner Sarah Chen leads the FinTech practice.

Following the close of their $250M Fund IV, Apex Horizon Capital LLC announced an expanded investment thesis. The firm is now leading growth rounds with larger check sizes between $5,000,000 and $10,000,000 ($5M - $10M) for Series A and Series B startups. Expanding beyond FinTech into Artificial Intelligence, ML, and Developer Tools. Operating out of San Francisco and New York, investing across the United States. Managing Director Alex Rivera noted aggressive deployment in generative AI infrastructure.

Apex Horizon VC European scout syndicate. We provide pre-seed and seed angel checks around $250k - $500k to European software founders. Based in London, United Kingdom. Interested in FinTech and Open Source software.

Bluecrest Growth Partners LP filed notice of exempt offering of securities for Bluecrest Fund II totaling $180,000,000. Stated strategy: Series B and Series C expansion capital. Targeting enterprise software and cybersecurity companies.

Bluecrest Ventures is an early-stage investor writing checks of $1M to $2.5M for Seed stage startups. Focus includes ClimateTech, Clean Energy, and Sustainability. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, investing across North America and Europe. Key signal: Co-led the $6M round for SolarGrid Systems.

Nordic Frontier Fund is a regional venture capital fund backing founders in the Nordics and Baltics (Sweden, Finland, Estonia, Norway). Typical ticket sizes range from €500,000 to €2,000,000 ($550k - $2.2M) at Seed and Series A. Key sectors: DeepTech, Robotics, and B2B SaaS. Managing Partner: Matti Virtanen. Portfolio includes RoboSense Nordic and KvanttiLab.
Nordic Frontier VC is a great tech fund in Helsinki. Very fast response time. Ticket size around €1M ($1.1M). Really helped us with hardware supply chain in Europe.

Verdant Seed Partners is a boutique fund dedicated exclusively to regenerative agriculture, biodiversity, and AgriTech. We partner with founders at the Pre-Seed and Seed stages. Founded by former agronomist Elena Rostova. No ticket size publicized; contact partners directly.

Soma Quantum Capital closed its maiden $75M fund to invest in Quantum Computing, Cryptography, and Advanced Semiconductors. Based in Austin, Texas, investing across North America and Asia-Pacific. Stage: Seed and Series A, writing checks of $2M to $4M. Announced participation in QuBit Dynamics $10M round.

Horizon Ventures is a venture capital firm based in Hong Kong. We back disruptive technology globally across Series A, Series B, and Growth. Ticket sizes $10,000,000 to $30,000,000 ($10M - $30M). Sectors: Biotech, Synthetic Biology, and Artificial Intelligence. Early backers of Zoom, DeepMind, and Spotify.
